name: DroneSimVR
summary:
Experience drone flight like never before with DroneSimVR, an immersive virtual reality simulator designed for aspiring pilots, drone enthusiasts, and professional training.

Learn the fundamentals of flight, improve your precision, and navigate challenging industrial environments without risking a real drone.

FEATURES

• Nine progressive training scenarios, from basic flight control to advanced industrial missions.
• Two distinct flight profiles for precision inspection and dynamic FPV flying.
• Physics-b
